rules.title: Front setback requirement
rules.description: Minimum 5 ft front setback for 5 Marla in approved schemes.

rules.title: Rear setback requirement
rules.description: Minimum 5 ft rear setback for 5 Marla residential plots.

rules.title: Side setback requirement
rules.description: No side setback required for 5 Marla plots in approved schemes.

rules.title: Maximum ground coverage
rules.description: Ground floor may cover maximum 75% of plot area.

rules.title: Maximum Floor Area Ratio
rules.description: Total covered area of all floors shall not exceed FAR 1:2.3.

rules.title: Maximum number of storeys
rules.description: Maximum of Ground + First + Second storey allowed.

rules.title: Maximum building height
rules.description: Total height of building shall not exceed 38 ft.

rules.title: Minimum clear height per storey
rules.description: Each storey (except basement) must have minimum 9 ft 6 in clear height.

rules.title: Maximum porch length
rules.description: Car porch length must not exceed 20 ft.

rules.title: Room above porch prohibition
rules.description: Room above porch is not allowed because 5 ft side space does not exist.

rules.title: Rear toilet maximum area
rules.description: Rear corner toilet/bath may not exceed 40 sq ft area.

rules.title: Rear toilet maximum height
rules.description: Rear corner toilet/bath height may not exceed 8 ft.

rules.title: Mandatory water tanks
rules.description: All houses above 3 Marla must have underground and overhead water tanks.

rules.title: Thermal insulation requirement
rules.description: External walls, roof, and windows must follow energy conservation standards.
